scenario: An `error` clause catches call errors gracefully per LCCO.8.1. A rule with a `call` action plus `error:` continuation runs without the engine crashing on missing adapter. The stream must not contain any engine_crash event.
rules_ds:
service svc.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
        error:
            log info "error handled"
